sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Retain the corrected qudt:unit sh:hasValue <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/UNITLESS>, the approval-record ownership/path, approved status, authority constraints, Category C context fields, and the unconstrained non-ice-strengthened Category C branch. Repair the A/B approvalStandard checks: the current broad regex accepts unrelated text merely containing “acceptable to the Organization” or “equivalent level of safety” (including negated or contextually unrelated statements). Encode the two permitted alternatives as bounded, semantically specific static alternatives: a standard acceptable to the Organization, or another/other standard offering an equivalent level of safety.
